error.message: Declared ASAR integrity for unpacked entry node_modules/btime/binding.node contradicts its companion file; packaging tools commonly sign or strip unpacked native binaries after writing the archive. If expected, rerun analyze_javascript_application with integrity_policy=record-and-continue (CLI: --integrity-policy record-and-continue) to retain observed bytes as untrusted; otherwise get a fresh copy.
